MORE CONFIDENCE FOR A
MORE INSPIRING DRIVE
The difference between a good drive and an inspiring one is confidence. That’s
why we equip every Mazda CX-5 with i-Activsense safety features1 which
alert you to hazards and help you avoid collisions or lessen their impact.
i-Activsense includes a host of standard safety innovations such as Smart City
Brake Support Front (SCBS-F)2,3 with forward-sensing Pedestrian Detection,3,4
along with available features like a 360° View Monitor,5,6 Smart City Brake
Support Rear (SCBS-R),2,3 windshield-projected colour Active Driving Display
(ADD),7 Traffic Sign Recognition system (TSR)7,8 and Driver Attention Alert.5
1 i-Activsense safety features are not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. Always check your mirrors. Be aware of the traffic around you. There are limitations to the range and detection of the
system. See Specifications and Features for availability. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.
Together, this suite of advanced safety features creates a more confident and
2 Smart City Brake Support Front is standard on all models. Smart City Brake Support Rear is available on the Signature model.
3 Automatic braking systems are not substitutes for safe and attentive driving and are only designed to reduce damage in the event of a collision. There are limitations to the operation and detection of
these systems. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details. inspiring experience for both you and your passengers.
4 Standard on all models. Operates under certain conditions while the vehicle is driven at a speed between about 4 and 80 km/h if the object is a vehicle ahead and about 10 to 80 km/h if the object is
a pedestrian. Not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the range and detection of the system. Factors including movement and shape of the object in front of the vehicle,
weather and road conditions can all impact automatic brake control and collision warning. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.
5 Standard on the Signature model.
6 360º View Monitor may not provide a comprehensive view of the entire surrounding area of this vehicle. Always check your surroundings visually. Please see your Owner’s Manual for further details.
7 Standard on the GT and Signature models.
8 TSR functionality may not be compatible with all regional road signs in Canada.
